articles.title: University of Limerick Student Center / Carr Cotter & Naessens
english: The University of Limerick Student Center, completed in 2025, is a landmark development designed to enhance student life on campus. This innovative structure serves as a central hub, fostering community engagement and facilitating academic collaboration among students.

Strategically positioned at the gateway to the university, the design combines functionality with striking architectural aesthetics. By incorporating sustainable materials and energy-efficient systems, the building reflects modern design principles and environmental responsibility.

The project showcases the vision of Carr Cotter & Naessens, blending contemporary design with the cultural heritage of the area. It aims to create an inviting atmosphere where students can relax, study, and interact, contributing to an enriched academic experience.
chinese: 利默里克大學學生中心於2025年完工，是一個旨在提升校園學生生活的地標性建築。這座創新的建築作為一個中心樞紐，促進了社區互動，並便利了學生之間的學術合作。
該建築戰略性地位於大學的入口處，設計巧妙地結合了實用性與引人注目的建築美學。通過採用可持續材料和節能系統，該建築反映了現代設計原則和環保責任。
這一項目展示了Carr Cotter & Naessens的願景，將當代設計與當地的文化遺產相融合。其目的是創造一個充滿邀請感的氛圍，讓學生可以放鬆、學習和互動，從而提升學術體驗。

articles.title: Ian Moore Architects transforms Sydney pub into house with "wall of light"
english: Ian Moore Architects has transformed a 19th-century pub in Sydney into a contemporary home named The Corner House, featuring a striking rear wing of glass bricks. This project highlights the adaptive reuse of a heritage building, carefully preserving its historical elements while modernizing its functionality. Located in Surry Hills, the house now offers three bedrooms and spacious living areas, showcasing a balance between old and new architectural styles.

To honor the building's original design, the architects implemented a steel frame to stabilize the structure, repairing its damaged brick shell. The main living areas are enhanced by a central courtyard that allows natural light and ventilation, promoting a sustainable living environment. This adaptation required careful planning to ensure that all new additions were distinct yet complementary to the historic fabric of the building.

Inside, The Corner House features an industrial aesthetic with a mix of oak and terrazzo flooring, and clean white walls. The careful restoration includes maintaining the original Victorian timber frames while modern updates enhance comfort and efficiency. By optimizing natural light and air circulation, the architects created a harmonious blend of heritage charm and contemporary design.
chinese: 伊恩·穆爾建築師事務所將悉尼一座19世紀的酒吧轉變為名為「角落之家」的現代住宅，特色是一個引人注目的玻璃磚後翼。這個項目突顯了對於歷史建築的適應性重用，精心保留其歷史元素，同時現代化其功能。位於沙利希爾斯，這座房子現在提供三間臥室和寬敞的起居空間，展現出舊與新建築風格之間的平衡。
為了尊重建築的原始設計，建築師採用了鋼框架以穩定結構，修復受損的磚石外殼。主要生活空間由一個中央庭院增強，該庭院允許自然光和通風，促進可持續生活環境。這種改建需要仔細規劃，以確保所有新添加的部分在保持與歷史建築相輔相成的同時，區分開來。
在內部，「角落之家」具有工業美學，鑲有橡木和水磨石地板，並配有潔白的牆壁。精心的修復工作保留了原始的維多利亞時代木窗框，而現代更新則增強了舒適性和效率。通過優化自然光和空氣流通，建築師創造出了一種遺產魅力與當代設計的和諧融合。

articles.title: this home in korea is shaped by twin timber gables atop a concrete base
english: The Shin-Dae-Ri House, designed by BRBB Architects in South Korea, exemplifies a harmonious blend of nature and architecture. Nestled between fields and forests, this residence serves as a transition from busy village life to peaceful mountain living for an elderly couple moving from Seoul. The design emphasizes gardening and seasonal change, enhancing the residents' connection to the landscape.

The architecture features a continuous concrete base that follows the natural slope of the terrain, providing stability and grounding for the structure. This solid foundation creates shaded outdoor zones with deep overhangs, facilitating outdoor activities while ensuring privacy and light within the enclosed courtyard. The thoughtful arrangement invites both rest and engagement with nature.

Atop the concrete base, two timber-clad gables rise with slight rotations, allowing varied views and light to filter through. The separation of these volumes creates a dynamic interplay between the indoors and outdoors. This design encourages an evolving perception of the surroundings, emphasizing the relationship between space and experience as residents transition through their home.
chinese: 新大里住宅由韓國的BRBB建築師設計，展現了自然與建築的和諧融合。這座住宅坐落於田野與森林之間，為一對從首爾搬來的老年夫婦提供了一個忙碌村莊生活與寧靜山地生活之間的過渡。其設計強調園藝與季節變化，增強居住者對自然景觀的聯繫。
建築採用一個持續的混凝土基座，隨著地形的自然坡度而形成，為建築提供了穩定性和基礎。這個堅實的基礎與深延伸的屋簷創造了陰影戶外區域，既便於戶外活動，又確保了包圍庭院內的隱私與光通透。這一周到的設計邀請居民在自然中休息和參與。
在混凝土基座的上方，兩個木製山形屋頂略微旋轉，讓不同的景觀視角和光線依次濾入。這些體量的分離創造出內外之間的動態互動。這個設計鼓勵居民在家中漫遊，隨著他們的移動，逐步感知四周的環境，強調了空間與經驗之間的關係。
